steps.message:
As an operator-planner in an Independent System Operator, you create a base case for tomorrow's peak hour each morning in order to establish the voltage profile and verify that the day-ahead market schedule is AC-feasible. In order to do this, you should use the model described in `math-model.md` to find a least-cost, AC feasible operating point and then produce a report in `report.json`. The report should follow the structure below with all power values in MW or MVAr, angles in degrees, voltages in per-unit.

```json

  "summary": {
    "total_cost_per_hour": 1234567.89,
    "total_load_MW": 144839.06,
    "total_load_MVAr": 29007.78,
    "total_generation_MW": 145200.00,
    "total_generation_MVAr": 32000.00,
    "total_losses_MW": 360.94,
    "solver_status": "optimal"
  },
  "generators": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "bus": 316,
      "pg_MW": 245.5,
      "qg_MVAr": 50.0,
      "pmin_MW": 0.0,
      "pmax_MW": 491.0,
      "qmin_MVAr": -246.0,
      "qmax_MVAr": 246.0
    }
  ],
  "buses": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "vm_pu": 1.02,
      "va_deg": -5.3,
      "vmin_pu": 0.9,
      "vmax_pu": 1.1
    }
  ],
  "most_loaded_branches": [
    {
      "from_bus": 123,
      "to_bus": 456,
      "loading_pct": 95.2,
      "flow_from_MVA": 571.2,
      "flow_to_MVA": 568.1,

  ],
  "feasibility_check": {

    "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": 0.002,
    "max_voltage_violation_pu": 0.0,
    "max_branch_overload_MVA": 0.0
  }
}
```
I'll help you create a base case for tomorrow's peak hour using the AC-feasible optimal power flow model. Let me start by exploring the directory structure and reading the math model.

# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver for ISO Base Case Creation
Uses the mathematical model from math-model.md to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp
import math
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

def load_network(filepath: str) -> Dict:
    """Load network data from JSON file in MATPOWER format"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    # Extract base MVA
    base_mva = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse bus data
    bus_fields = {
        'bus_id': 0, 'bus_type': 1, 'pd': 2, 'qd': 3, 'gs': 4, 'bs': 5,
        'area': 6, 'vm': 7, 'va': 8, 'base_kv': 9, 'zone': 10, 'vmax': 11, 'vmin': 12
    }

    buses = []
    for b in data['bus']:
        buses.append({
            'bus_id': int(b[bus_fields['bus_id']]),
            'bus_type': int(b[bus_fields['bus_type']]),
            'pd': b[bus_fields['pd']],
            'qd': b[bus_fields['qd']],
            'gs': b[bus_fields['gs']],
            'bs': b[bus_fields['bs']],
            'area': b[bus_fields['area']],
            'vm': b[bus_fields['vm']],
            'va': b[bus_fields['va']],
            'base_kv': b[bus_fields['base_kv']],
            'zone': b[bus_fields['zone']],
            'vmax': b[bus_fields['vmax']],
            'vmin': b[bus_fields['vmin']]
        })

    # Parse generator data
    gen_fields = {
        'gen_bus': 0, 'pg': 1, 'qg': 2, 'qmax': 3, 'qmin': 4,
        'vg': 5, 'mbase': 6, 'status': 7, 'pmax': 8, 'pmin': 9
    }

    generators = []
    for g in data['gen']:
        generators.append({
            'gen_bus': int(g[gen_fields['gen_bus']]),
            'pg': g[gen_fields['pg']],
            'qg': g[gen_fields['qg']],
            'qmax': g[gen_fields['qmax']],
            'qmin': g[gen_fields['qmin']],
            'vg': g[gen_fields['vg']],
            'mbase': g[gen_fields['mbase']],
            'status': int(g[gen_fields['status']]),
            'pmax': g[gen_fields['pmax']],
            'pmin': g[gen_fields['pmin']]
        })

    # Parse branch data
    branch_fields = {
        'f_bus': 0, 't_bus': 1, 'br_r': 2, 'br_x': 3, 'br_b': 4,
        'rate_a': 5, 'rate_b': 6, 'rate_c': 7, 'ratio': 8, 'angle': 9,
        'status': 10, 'angmin': 11, 'angmax': 12
    }

    branches = []

        constraints.append(angle_diff <= math.radians(br['angmax']))

def calculate_branch_flows(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """Calculate branch power flows"""
    buses = network_data['buses']

        s_to_mva = np.abs(s_to)

def generate_report(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the report in the required JSON format"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']

    most_loaded = sorted(flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]

    # Format generator data
    gen_data = []
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:
            gen_data.append({

                'bus': gen['gen_bus'],

                'qmin_MVAr': float(gen['qmin']),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(gen['qmax'])
            })

    # Format bus data

    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        bus_data.append({
            'id': bus['bus_id'],
            'vm_pu': float(solution['vm'][i]),
            'va_deg': float(np.degrees(solution['va'][i])),
            'vmin_pu': float(bus['vmin']),
            'vmax_pu': float(bus['vmax'])
        })

    # Format most loaded branches
    most_loaded_branches = []
    for flow in most_loaded:
        most_loaded_branches.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': float(flow['loading_pct']),
            'flow_from_MVA': float(flow['s_from_mva']),
            'flow_to_MVA': float(flow['s_to_mva']),
            'limit_MVA': float(flow['limit'])
        })

    # Determine solver status
    solver_status = "optimal" if solution['status'] == "optimal" else "infeasible"

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": float(solution['objective_value']) if solution['objective_value'] is not None else 0.0,
            "total_load_MW": float(total_pd),
            "total_load_MVAr": float(total_qd),

            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_voltage_violation),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_branch_overload)
        }
    }

    return report

def main():
    """Main execution function"""
    print("Loading network data...")

    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")

    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")

        qg_sum = cp.sum([qg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        # Calculate power injection from loads (negative values)
        pd = bus['pd']
        qd = bus['qd']

        # Calculate power flow through branches
        pf_from = 0.0  # Real power flowing out from bus
        qf_from = 0.0  # Reactive power flowing out from bus

        pf_to = 0.0    # Real power flowing into bus
        qf_to = 0.0    # Reactive power flowing into bus

        for br in branches:
            if br['status'] != 1:  # Branch is out of service
                continue

            f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
            t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

            if f_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "from" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                angle_shift = br['angle'] * math.pi / 180

                # Calculate branch admittance
                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                # Voltage at buses
                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                # Apply transformer
                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from f to t
                s_flow = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
                pf_from += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_from += cp.imag(s_flow)

            elif t_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "to" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0

                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
                t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from t to f (reverse direction)
                s_flow = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)
                pf_to += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_to += cp.imag(s_flow)

        # Net power injection = generation - load
        net_p = pg_sum - pd
        net_q = qg_sum - qd

        # Power balance: net injection = power flowing out
        constraints.append(net_p == pf_from + pf_to)
        constraints.append(net_q == qf_from + qf_to)

    # 5. Branch thermal limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)

        # Limit apparent power flow
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_from) <= limit)
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_to) <= limit)

    # 6. Voltage angle difference limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        angle_diff = va[f_bus_idx] - va[t_bus_idx]
        constraints.append(angle_diff >= math.radians(br['angmin']))
        constraints.append(angle_diff <= math.radians(br['angmax']))

    # Objective function: minimize generation cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] != 1:
            continue

        cost_data = gencost[i] if i < len(gencost) else {'model': 2, 'cost': [0, 1, 0]}
        cost_coeffs = cost_data['cost']

        if len(cost_coeffs) >= 3:
            c2, c1, c0 = cost_coeffs[-3], cost_coeffs[-2], cost_coeffs[-1]
        else:
            c2, c1, c0 = 0, 1, 0

        # Cost is quadratic in MW (convert to $/hr)
        total_cost += c2 * (pg[i] ** 2) + c1 * pg[i] + c0

    objective = cp.Minimize(total_cost)

    # Solve the problem
    problem = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)

    try:
        problem.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL, verbose=True)

        if problem.status in ["infeasible", "unbounded"]:
            status = "infeasible"
        else:
            status = "optimal"

        # Extract results
        result = {
            'status': status,
            'vm': vm.value,
            'va': va.value,
            'pg': pg.value,
            'qg': qg.value,
            'objective_value': problem.objective.value
        }

        return result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error solving AC-OPF: {e}")
        return {
            'status': 'error',
            'error': str(e)
        }

def calculate_branch_flows(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """Calculate branch power flows"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    flows = []
    vm = solution['vm']
    va = solution['va']

    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * np.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * np.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * np.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * np.conj(vf * y)

        pf_from = np.real(s_from)
        qf_from = np.imag(s_from)
        pf_to = np.real(s_to)
        qf_to = np.imag(s_to)

        s_from_mva = np.abs(s_from)
        s_to_mva = np.abs(s_to)

        loading = max(s_from_mva, s_to_mva) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['f_bus'],
            'to_bus': br['t_bus'],
            'pf_from': pf_from,
            'qf_from': qf_from,
            'pt_from': pf_to,
            'qt_from': qf_to,
            's_from_mva': s_from_mva,
            's_to_mva': s_to_mva,
            'limit': limit,
            'loading_pct': loading
        })

    return flows

def generate_report(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the report in the required JSON format"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    # Calculate summary statistics
    total_pg = np.sum(solution['pg'])
    total_qg = np.sum(solution['qg'])
    total_pd = np.sum([b['pd'] for b in buses])
    total_qd = np.sum([b['qd'] for b in buses])
    total_losses = total_pg - total_pd

    # Calculate feasibility metrics
    max_p_mismatch = 0.0
    max_q_mismatch = 0.0
    max_voltage_violation = 0.0
    max_branch_overload = 0.0

    # Check power balance at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        # Get generators at this bus
        gen_indices = [idx for idx, g in enumerate(generators) if g['gen_bus'] == bus['bus_id']]

        pg_sum = np.sum([solution['pg'][idx] for idx in gen_indices])
        qg_sum = np.sum([solution['qg'][idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        mismatch_p = abs(pg_sum - bus['pd'])
        mismatch_q = abs(qg_sum - bus['qd'])

        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, mismatch_p)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, mismatch_q)

        # Check voltage violations
        vm = solution['vm'][i]
        if vm > bus['vmax']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, vm - bus['vmax'])
        elif vm < bus['vmin']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, bus['vmin'] - vm)

    # Calculate branch flows
    flows = calculate_branch_flows(network_data, solution)

    # Check branch overloads
    for flow in flows:
        if flow['s_from_mva'] > flow['limit']:
            overload = flow['s_from_mva'] - flow['limit']
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Get most loaded branches
    most_loaded = sorted(flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]

    # Format generator data
    gen_data = []
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:
            gen_data.append({
                'id': i + 1,
                'bus': gen['gen_bus'],
                'pg_MW': float(solution['pg'][i]),
                'qg_MVAr': float(solution['qg'][i]),
                'pmin_MW': float(gen['pmin']),
                'pmax_MW': float(gen['pmax']),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(gen['qmin']),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(gen['qmax'])
            })

    # Format bus data
    bus_data = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        bus_data.append({
            'id': bus['bus_id'],
            'vm_pu': float(solution['vm'][i]),
            'va_deg': float(np.degrees(solution['va'][i])),
            'vmin_pu': float(bus['vmin']),
            'vmax_pu': float(bus['vmax'])
        })

    # Format most loaded branches
    most_loaded_branches = []
    for flow in most_loaded:
        most_loaded_branches.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': float(flow['loading_pct']),
            'flow_from_MVA': float(flow['s_from_mva']),
            'flow_to_MVA': float(flow['s_to_mva']),
            'limit_MVA': float(flow['limit'])
        })

    # Determine solver status
    solver_status = "optimal" if solution['status'] == "optimal" else "infeasible"

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": float(solution['objective_value']) if solution['objective_value'] is not None else 0.0,
            "total_load_MW": float(total_pd),
            "total_load_MVAr": float(total_qd),
            "total_generation_MW": float(total_pg),
            "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_qg),
            "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses),
            "solver_status": solver_status
        },
        "generators": gen_data,
        "buses": bus_data,
        "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded_branches,
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": float(max_p_mismatch),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mismatch),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_voltage_violation),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_branch_overload)
        }
    }

    return report

def main():
    """Main execution function"""
    print("Loading network data...")
    network_data = load_network('network.json')

    print(f"Network loaded:")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['buses'])} buses")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['generators'])} generators")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['branches'])} branches")

    print("\nSolving AC-OPF...")
    solution = solve_acopf(network_data)

    if solution['status'] != 'optimal':
        print(f"Warning: Solution status is {solution['status']}")

    print("\nGenerating report...")
    report = generate_report(network_data, solution)

    print("\nWriting report to report.json...")
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nSummary:")
    print(f"  Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"  Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")

    print("\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.6f} MVA")

    print("\nReport written to report.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver for ISO Base Case Creation
Uses the mathematical model from math-model.md to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp
import math
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

def load_network(filepath: str) -> Dict:
    """Load network data from JSON file in MATPOWER format"""
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    # Extract base MVA
    base_mva = data['baseMVA']

    # Parse bus data
    bus_fields = {
        'bus_id': 0, 'bus_type': 1, 'pd': 2, 'qd': 3, 'gs': 4, 'bs': 5,
        'area': 6, 'vm': 7, 'va': 8, 'base_kv': 9, 'zone': 10, 'vmax': 11, 'vmin': 12
    }

    buses = []
    for b in data['bus']:
        buses.append({
            'bus_id': int(b[bus_fields['bus_id']]),
            'bus_type': int(b[bus_fields['bus_type']]),
            'pd': b[bus_fields['pd']],
            'qd': b[bus_fields['qd']],
            'gs': b[bus_fields['gs']],
            'bs': b[bus_fields['bs']],
            'area': b[bus_fields['area']],
            'vm': b[bus_fields['vm']],
            'va': b[bus_fields['va']],
            'base_kv': b[bus_fields['base_kv']],
            'zone': b[bus_fields['zone']],
            'vmax': b[bus_fields['vmax']],
            'vmin': b[bus_fields['vmin']]
        })

    # Parse generator data
    gen_fields = {
        'gen_bus': 0, 'pg': 1, 'qg': 2, 'qmax': 3, 'qmin': 4,
        'vg': 5, 'mbase': 6, 'status': 7, 'pmax': 8, 'pmin': 9
    }

    generators = []
    for g in data['gen']:
        generators.append({
            'gen_bus': int(g[gen_fields['gen_bus']]),
            'pg': g[gen_fields['pg']],
            'qg': g[gen_fields['qg']],
            'qmax': g[gen_fields['qmax']],
            'qmin': g[gen_fields['qmin']],
            'vg': g[gen_fields['vg']],
            'mbase': g[gen_fields['mbase']],
            'status': int(g[gen_fields['status']]),
            'pmax': g[gen_fields['pmax']],
            'pmin': g[gen_fields['pmin']]
        })

    # Parse branch data
    branch_fields = {
        'f_bus': 0, 't_bus': 1, 'br_r': 2, 'br_x': 3, 'br_b': 4,
        'rate_a': 5, 'rate_b': 6, 'rate_c': 7, 'ratio': 8, 'angle': 9,
        'status': 10, 'angmin': 11, 'angmax': 12
    }

    branches = []
    for br in data['branch']:
        branches.append({
            'f_bus': int(br[branch_fields['f_bus']]),
            't_bus': int(br[branch_fields['t_bus']]),
            'br_r': br[branch_fields['br_r']],
            'br_x': br[branch_fields['br_x']],
            'br_b': br[branch_fields['br_b']],
            'rate_a': br[branch_fields['rate_a']],
            'ratio': br[branch_fields['ratio']],
            'angle': br[branch_fields['angle']],
            'status': int(br[branch_fields['status']]),
            'angmin': br[branch_fields['angmin']],
            'angmax': br[branch_fields['angmax']]
        })

    # Parse generator cost data
    gencost = []
    for gc in data['gencost']:
        model = int(gc[0])
        startup = gc[1]
        shutdown = gc[2]
        ncost = int(gc[3])
        cost_coeffs = gc[4:]
        gencost.append({
            'model': model,
            'startup': startup,
            'shutdown': shutdown,
            'ncost': ncost,
            'cost': cost_coeffs
        })

    return {
        'base_mva': base_mva,
        'buses': buses,
        'generators': generators,
        'branches': branches,
        'gencost': gencost
    }

def solve_acopf(network_data: Dict) -> Dict:
    """
    Solve AC-OPF using the mathematical model from math-model.md
    """
    base_mva = network_data['base_mva']
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    gencost = network_data['gencost']

    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)
    n_branches = len(branches)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}
    gen_bus_to_idx = {g['gen_bus']: i for i, g in enumerate(generators)}

    # Identify reference bus (type == 3)
    ref_bus_idx = None
    for i, b in enumerate(buses):
        if b['bus_type'] == 3:
            ref_bus_idx = i
            break

    if ref_bus_idx is None:
        ref_bus_idx = 0  # Default to first bus

    # Variables
    # Bus voltage magnitudes and angles
    vm = cp.Variable(n_buses, pos=True, name='vm')  # Voltage magnitude
    va = cp.Variable(n_buses, name='va')  # Voltage angle

    # Generator real and reactive power
    pg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='pg')  # Real power
    qg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='qg')  # Reactive power

    # Constraints
    constraints = []

    # 1. Reference bus angle constraint: angle = 0
    constraints.append(va[ref_bus_idx] == 0)

    # 2. Generator power bounds
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:  # Generator is on
            constraints.append(pg[i] >= gen['pmin'])
            constraints.append(pg[i] <= gen['pmax'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] >= gen['qmin'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] <= gen['qmax'])
        else:
            # Generator is off
            constraints.append(pg[i] == 0)
            constraints.append(qg[i] == 0)

    # 3. Voltage magnitude bounds
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        constraints.append(vm[i] >= bus['vmin'])
        constraints.append(vm[i] <= bus['vmax'])

    # 4. Power balance equations at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        # Get generators connected to this bus
        gen_indices = [idx for idx, g in enumerate(generators) if g['gen_bus'] == bus['bus_id']]

        # Calculate power injection from generators
        pg_sum = cp.sum([pg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])
        qg_sum = cp.sum([qg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        # Calculate power injection from loads (negative values)
        pd = bus['pd']
        qd = bus['qd']

        # Calculate power flow through branches
        pf_from = 0.0  # Real power flowing out from bus
        qf_from = 0.0  # Reactive power flowing out from bus

        pf_to = 0.0    # Real power flowing into bus
        qf_to = 0.0    # Reactive power flowing into bus

        for br in branches:
            if br['status'] != 1:  # Branch is out of service
                continue

            f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
            t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

            if f_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "from" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                angle_shift = br['angle'] * math.pi / 180

                # Calculate branch admittance
                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                # Voltage at buses
                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                # Apply transformer
                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from f to t
                s_flow = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
                pf_from += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_from += cp.imag(s_flow)

            elif t_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "to" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0

                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
                t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from t to f (reverse direction)
                s_flow = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)
                pf_to += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_to += cp.imag(s_flow)

        # Net power injection = generation - load
        net_p = pg_sum - pd
        net_q = qg_sum - qd

        # Power balance: net injection = power flowing out
        constraints.append(net_p == pf_from + pf_to)
        constraints.append(net_q == qf_from + qf_to)

    # 5. Branch thermal limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)

        # Limit apparent power flow
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_from) <= limit)
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_to) <= limit)

    # 6. Voltage angle difference limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        angle_diff = va[f_bus_idx] - va[t_bus_idx]
        constraints.append(angle_diff >= math.radians(br['angmin']))
        constraints.append(angle_diff <= math.radians(br['angmax']))

    # Objective function: minimize generation cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] != 1:
            continue

        cost_data = gencost[i] if i < len(gencost) else {'model': 2, 'cost': [0, 1, 0]}
        cost_coeffs = cost_data['cost']

        if len(cost_coeffs) >= 3:
            c2, c1, c0 = cost_coeffs[-3], cost_coeffs[-2], cost_coeffs[-1]
        else:
            c2, c1, c0 = 0, 1, 0

        # Cost is quadratic in MW (convert to $/hr)
        total_cost += c2 * (pg[i] ** 2) + c1 * pg[i] + c0

    objective = cp.Minimize(total_cost)

    # Solve the problem
    problem = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)

    try:
        problem.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL, verbose=True)

        if problem.status in ["infeasible", "unbounded"]:
            status = "infeasible"
        else:
            status = "optimal"

        # Extract results
        result = {
            'status': status,
            'vm': vm.value,
            'va': va.value,
            'pg': pg.value,
            'qg': qg.value,
            'objective_value': problem.objective.value
        }

        return result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error solving AC-OPF: {e}")
        return {
            'status': 'error',
            'error': str(e)
        }

def calculate_branch_flows(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """Calculate branch power flows"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    flows = []
    vm = solution['vm']
    va = solution['va']

    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * np.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * np.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * np.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * np.conj(vf * y)

        pf_from = np.real(s_from)
        qf_from = np.imag(s_from)
        pf_to = np.real(s_to)
        qf_to = np.imag(s_to)

        s_from_mva = np.abs(s_from)
        s_to_mva = np.abs(s_to)

        loading = max(s_from_mva, s_to_mva) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['f_bus'],
            'to_bus': br['t_bus'],
            'pf_from': pf_from,
            'qf_from': qf_from,
            'pt_from': pf_to,
            'qt_from': qf_to,
            's_from_mva': s_from_mva,
            's_to_mva': s_to_mva,
            'limit': limit,
            'loading_pct': loading
        })

    return flows

def generate_report(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the report in the required JSON format"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    # Calculate summary statistics
    total_pg = np.sum(solution['pg'])
    total_qg = np.sum(solution['qg'])
    total_pd = np.sum([b['pd'] for b in buses])
    total_qd = np.sum([b['qd'] for b in buses])
    total_losses = total_pg - total_pd

    # Calculate feasibility metrics
    max_p_mismatch = 0.0
    max_q_mismatch = 0.0
    max_voltage_violation = 0.0
    max_branch_overload = 0.0

    # Check power balance at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        # Get generators at this bus
        gen_indices = [idx for idx, g in enumerate(generators) if g['gen_bus'] == bus['bus_id']]

        pg_sum = np.sum([solution['pg'][idx] for idx in gen_indices])
        qg_sum = np.sum([solution['qg'][idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        mismatch_p = abs(pg_sum - bus['pd'])
        mismatch_q = abs(qg_sum - bus['qd'])

        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, mismatch_p)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, mismatch_q)

        # Check voltage violations
        vm = solution['vm'][i]
        if vm > bus['vmax']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, vm - bus['vmax'])
        elif vm < bus['vmin']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, bus['vmin'] - vm)

    # Calculate branch flows
    flows = calculate_branch_flows(network_data, solution)

    # Check branch overloads
    for flow in flows:
        if flow['s_from_mva'] > flow['limit']:
            overload = flow['s_from_mva'] - flow['limit']
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Get most loaded branches
    most_loaded = sorted(flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]

    # Format generator data
    gen_data = []
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:
            gen_data.append({
                'id': i + 1,
                'bus': gen['gen_bus'],
                'pg_MW': float(solution['pg'][i]),
                'qg_MVAr': float(solution['qg'][i]),
                'pmin_MW': float(gen['pmin']),
                'pmax_MW': float(gen['pmax']),
                'qmin_MVAr': float(gen['qmin']),
                'qmax_MVAr': float(gen['qmax'])
            })

    # Format bus data
    bus_data = []
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        bus_data.append({
            'id': bus['bus_id'],
            'vm_pu': float(solution['vm'][i]),
            'va_deg': float(np.degrees(solution['va'][i])),
            'vmin_pu': float(bus['vmin']),
            'vmax_pu': float(bus['vmax'])
        })

    # Format most loaded branches
    most_loaded_branches = []
    for flow in most_loaded:
        most_loaded_branches.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': float(flow['loading_pct']),
            'flow_from_MVA': float(flow['s_from_mva']),
            'flow_to_MVA': float(flow['s_to_mva']),
            'limit_MVA': float(flow['limit'])
        })

    # Determine solver status
    solver_status = "optimal" if solution['status'] == "optimal" else "infeasible"

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": float(solution['objective_value']) if solution['objective_value'] is not None else 0.0,
            "total_load_MW": float(total_pd),
            "total_load_MVAr": float(total_qd),
            "total_generation_MW": float(total_pg),
            "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_qg),
            "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses),
            "solver_status": solver_status
        },
        "generators": gen_data,
        "buses": bus_data,
        "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded_branches,
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": float(max_p_mismatch),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mismatch),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_voltage_violation),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_branch_overload)
        }
    }

    return report

def main():
    """Main execution function"""
    print("Loading network data...")
    network_data = load_network('network.json')

    print(f"Network loaded:")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['buses'])} buses")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['generators'])} generators")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['branches'])} branches")

    print("\nSolving AC-OPF...")
    solution = solve_acopf(network_data)

    if solution['status'] != 'optimal':
        print(f"Warning: Solution status is {solution['status']}")

    print("\nGenerating report...")
    report = generate_report(network_data, solution)

    print("\nWriting report to report.json...")
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nSummary:")
    print(f"  Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"  Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")

    print("\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.6f} MVA")

    print("\nReport written to report.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""

Uses the mathematical model from math-model.md to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp
import math
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

def load_network(filepath: str) -> Dict:
    """Load network data from JSON file in MATPOWER format"""

            'qmin': g[gen_fields['qmin']],
            'vg': g[gen_fields['vg']],

            'br_r': br[branch_fields['br_r']],
            'br_x': br[branch_fields['br_x']],
            'br_b': br[branch_fields['br_b']],
            'rate_a': br[branch_fields['rate_a']],
            'ratio': br[branch_fields['ratio']],
            'angle': br[branch_fields['angle']],
            'status': int(br[branch_fields['status']]),

        })

    # Parse generator cost data
    gencost = []
    for gc in data['gencost']:
        model = int(gc[0])
        startup = gc[1]
        shutdown = gc[2]

        gencost.append({
            'model': model,
            'startup': startup,

        })

    return {
        'base_mva': base_mva,
        'buses': buses,
        'generators': generators,
        'branches': branches,
        'gencost': gencost
    }

def solve_acopf(network_data: Dict) -> Dict:
    """
    Solve AC-OPF using the mathematical model from math-model.md
    """
    base_mva = network_data['base_mva']
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    gencost = network_data['gencost']

    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)
    n_branches = len(branches)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}
    gen_bus_to_idx = {g['gen_bus']: i for i, g in enumerate(generators)}

    # Identify reference bus (type == 3)
    ref_bus_idx = None
    for i, b in enumerate(buses):
        if b['bus_type'] == 3:
            ref_bus_idx = i
            break

    if ref_bus_idx is None:
        ref_bus_idx = 0  # Default to first bus

    # Variables
    # Bus voltage magnitudes and angles
    vm = cp.Variable(n_buses, pos=True, name='vm')  # Voltage magnitude
    va = cp.Variable(n_buses, name='va')  # Voltage angle

    # Generator real and reactive power
    pg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='pg')  # Real power
    qg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='qg')  # Reactive power

    # Constraints
    constraints = []

    # 1. Reference bus angle constraint: angle = 0
    constraints.append(va[ref_bus_idx] == 0)

    # 2. Generator power bounds
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:  # Generator is on
            constraints.append(pg[i] >= gen['pmin'])
            constraints.append(pg[i] <= gen['pmax'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] >= gen['qmin'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] <= gen['qmax'])
        else:
            # Generator is off
            constraints.append(pg[i] == 0)
            constraints.append(qg[i] == 0)

    # 3. Voltage magnitude bounds
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        constraints.append(vm[i] >= bus['vmin'])
        constraints.append(vm[i] <= bus['vmax'])

    # 4. Power balance equations at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        # Get generators connected to this bus
        gen_indices = [idx for idx, g in enumerate(generators) if g['gen_bus'] == bus['bus_id']]

        # Calculate power injection from generators
        pg_sum = cp.sum([pg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])
        qg_sum = cp.sum([qg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        # Calculate power injection from loads (negative values)
        pd = bus['pd']
        qd = bus['qd']

        # Calculate power flow through branches
        pf_from = 0.0  # Real power flowing out from bus
        qf_from = 0.0  # Reactive power flowing out from bus

        pf_to = 0.0    # Real power flowing into bus
        qf_to = 0.0    # Reactive power flowing into bus

        for br in branches:
            if br['status'] != 1:  # Branch is out of service
                continue

            f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
            t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

            if f_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "from" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                angle_shift = br['angle'] * math.pi / 180

                # Calculate branch admittance
                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                # Voltage at buses
                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                # Apply transformer
                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from f to t
                s_flow = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
                pf_from += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_from += cp.imag(s_flow)

            elif t_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "to" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0

                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
                t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from t to f (reverse direction)
                s_flow = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)
                pf_to += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_to += cp.imag(s_flow)

        # Net power injection = generation - load
        net_p = pg_sum - pd
        net_q = qg_sum - qd

        # Power balance: net injection = power flowing out
        constraints.append(net_p == pf_from + pf_to)
        constraints.append(net_q == qf_from + qf_to)

    # 5. Branch thermal limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)

        # Limit apparent power flow
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_from) <= limit)
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_to) <= limit)

    # 6. Voltage angle difference limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        angle_diff = va[f_bus_idx] - va[t_bus_idx]
        constraints.append(angle_diff >= math.radians(br['angmin']))
        constraints.append(angle_diff <= math.radians(br['angmax']))

    # Objective function: minimize generation cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] != 1:
            continue

        cost_data = gencost[i] if i < len(gencost) else {'model': 2, 'cost': [0, 1, 0]}
        cost_coeffs = cost_data['cost']

        if len(cost_coeffs) >= 3:
            c2, c1, c0 = cost_coeffs[-3], cost_coeffs[-2], cost_coeffs[-1]
        else:
            c2, c1, c0 = 0, 1, 0

        # Cost is quadratic in MW (convert to $/hr)
        total_cost += c2 * (pg[i] ** 2) + c1 * pg[i] + c0

    objective = cp.Minimize(total_cost)

    # Solve the problem
    problem = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)

    try:
        problem.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL, verbose=True)

        if problem.status in ["infeasible", "unbounded"]:
            status = "infeasible"
        else:
            status = "optimal"

        # Extract results
        result = {
            'status': status,
            'vm': vm.value,
            'va': va.value,
            'pg': pg.value,
            'qg': qg.value,
            'objective_value': problem.objective.value
        }

        return result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error solving AC-OPF: {e}")
        return {
            'status': 'error',
            'error': str(e)
        }

def calculate_branch_flows(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """Calculate branch power flows"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    flows = []
    vm = solution['vm']
    va = solution['va']

    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * np.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * np.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * np.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * np.conj(vf * y)

        pf_from = np.real(s_from)
        qf_from = np.imag(s_from)
        pf_to = np.real(s_to)
        qf_to = np.imag(s_to)

        s_from_mva = np.abs(s_from)
        s_to_mva = np.abs(s_to)

        loading = max(s_from_mva, s_to_mva) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['f_bus'],

            's_from_mva': s_from_mva,
            's_to_mva': s_to_mva,
            'limit': limit,
            'loading_pct': loading
        })

    return flows

def generate_report(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the report in the required JSON format"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    total_qg = np.sum(solution['qg'])
    total_pd = np.sum([b['pd'] for b in buses])
    total_qd = np.sum([b['qd'] for b in buses])
    total_losses = total_pg - total_pd

    # Calculate feasibility metrics
    max_p_mismatch = 0.0
    max_q_mismatch = 0.0
    max_voltage_violation = 0.0
    max_branch_overload = 0.0

    # Check power balance at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):

        mismatch_q = abs(qg_sum - bus['qd'])

        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, mismatch_p)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, mismatch_q)

        # Check voltage violations
        vm = solution['vm'][i]
        if vm > bus['vmax']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, vm - bus['vmax'])
        elif vm < bus['vmin']:
            max_voltage_violation = max(max_voltage_violation, bus['vmin'] - vm)

    # Calculate branch flows
    flows = calculate_branch_flows(network_data, solution)

    # Check branch overloads
    for flow in flows:
        if flow['s_from_mva'] > flow['limit']:

            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Get most loaded branches

    gen_data = []
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:

            })

    # Format bus data

        })

    # Format most loaded branches
    most_loaded_branches = []
    for flow in most_loaded:
        most_loaded_branches.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': float(flow['loading_pct']),
            'flow_from_MVA': float(flow['s_from_mva']),
            'flow_to_MVA': float(flow['s_to_mva']),
            'limit_MVA': float(flow['limit'])
        })

    # Determine solver status
    solver_status = "optimal" if solution['status'] == "optimal" else "infeasible"

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": float(solution['objective_value']) if solution['objective_value'] is not None else 0.0,
            "total_load_MW": float(total_pd),

            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_voltage_violation),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_branch_overload)
        }
    }

    return report

def main():
    """Main execution function"""
    print("Loading network data...")
    network_data = load_network('network.json')

    print(f"Network loaded:")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver for ISO Base Case Creation
Uses the mathematical model from math-model.md to find least-cost, AC-feasible operating point
"""

import json
import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp
import math
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

def load_network(filepath: str) -> Dict:

            'qmin': g[gen_fields['qmin']],
            'vg': g[gen_fields['vg']],

        })

def solve_acopf(network_data: Dict) -> Dict:
    """
    Solve AC-OPF using the mathematical model from math-model.md
    """
    base_mva = network_data['base_mva']
    buses = network_data['buses']
    generators = network_data['generators']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    gencost = network_data['gencost']

    n_buses = len(buses)
    n_gens = len(generators)
    n_branches = len(branches)

    # Create bus index mapping
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}
    gen_bus_to_idx = {g['gen_bus']: i for i, g in enumerate(generators)}

    # Identify reference bus (type == 3)
    ref_bus_idx = None
    for i, b in enumerate(buses):
        if b['bus_type'] == 3:
            ref_bus_idx = i
            break

    if ref_bus_idx is None:
        ref_bus_idx = 0  # Default to first bus

    # Variables
    # Bus voltage magnitudes and angles
    vm = cp.Variable(n_buses, pos=True, name='vm')  # Voltage magnitude
    va = cp.Variable(n_buses, name='va')  # Voltage angle

    # Generator real and reactive power
    pg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='pg')  # Real power
    qg = cp.Variable(n_gens, name='qg')  # Reactive power

    # Constraints
    constraints = []

    # 1. Reference bus angle constraint: angle = 0
    constraints.append(va[ref_bus_idx] == 0)

    # 2. Generator power bounds
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:  # Generator is on
            constraints.append(pg[i] >= gen['pmin'])
            constraints.append(pg[i] <= gen['pmax'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] >= gen['qmin'])
            constraints.append(qg[i] <= gen['qmax'])
        else:
            # Generator is off
            constraints.append(pg[i] == 0)
            constraints.append(qg[i] == 0)

    # 3. Voltage magnitude bounds
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        constraints.append(vm[i] >= bus['vmin'])
        constraints.append(vm[i] <= bus['vmax'])

    # 4. Power balance equations at each bus
    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):
        # Get generators connected to this bus
        gen_indices = [idx for idx, g in enumerate(generators) if g['gen_bus'] == bus['bus_id']]

        # Calculate power injection from generators
        pg_sum = cp.sum([pg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])
        qg_sum = cp.sum([qg[idx] for idx in gen_indices])

        # Calculate power injection from loads (negative values)
        pd = bus['pd']
        qd = bus['qd']

        # Calculate power flow through branches
        pf_from = 0.0  # Real power flowing out from bus
        qf_from = 0.0  # Reactive power flowing out from bus

        pf_to = 0.0    # Real power flowing into bus
        qf_to = 0.0    # Reactive power flowing into bus

        for br in branches:
            if br['status'] != 1:  # Branch is out of service
                continue

            f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
            t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

            if f_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "from" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
                angle_shift = br['angle'] * math.pi / 180

                # Calculate branch admittance
                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                # Voltage at buses
                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                # Apply transformer
                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from f to t
                s_flow = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
                pf_from += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_from += cp.imag(s_flow)

            elif t_bus_idx == i:
                # This bus is the "to" bus
                r = br['br_r']
                x = br['br_x']
                b = br['br_b']
                tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0

                y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
                y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

                f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
                t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

                vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
                vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

                if tap != 1.0:
                    vf = vf / tap

                # Complex power flow from t to f (reverse direction)
                s_flow = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)
                pf_to += cp.real(s_flow)
                qf_to += cp.imag(s_flow)

        # Net power injection = generation - load
        net_p = pg_sum - pd
        net_q = qg_sum - qd

        # Power balance: net injection = power flowing out
        constraints.append(net_p == pf_from + pf_to)
        constraints.append(net_q == qf_from + qf_to)

    # 5. Branch thermal limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        r = br['br_r']
        x = br['br_x']
        b = br['br_b']
        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0
        limit = br['rate_a'] if br['rate_a'] > 0 else 1e6

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        y_shunt = 1j * b / 2.0

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * cp.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * cp.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * cp.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * cp.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * cp.conj(vf * y)

        # Limit apparent power flow
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_from) <= limit)
        constraints.append(cp.abs(s_to) <= limit)

    # 6. Voltage angle difference limits
    for br in branches:
        if br['status'] != 1:
            continue

        f_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['f_bus']]
        t_bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[br['t_bus']]

        angle_diff = va[f_bus_idx] - va[t_bus_idx]
        constraints.append(angle_diff >= math.radians(br['angmin']))
        constraints.append(angle_diff <= math.radians(br['angmax']))

    # Objective function: minimize generation cost
    total_cost = 0.0
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] != 1:
            continue

        cost_data = gencost[i] if i < len(gencost) else {'model': 2, 'cost': [0, 1, 0]}
        cost_coeffs = cost_data['cost']

        if len(cost_coeffs) >= 3:
            c2, c1, c0 = cost_coeffs[-3], cost_coeffs[-2], cost_coeffs[-1]
        else:
            c2, c1, c0 = 0, 1, 0

        # Cost is quadratic in MW (convert to $/hr)
        total_cost += c2 * (pg[i] ** 2) + c1 * pg[i] + c0

    objective = cp.Minimize(total_cost)

    # Solve the problem
    problem = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)

    try:
        problem.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL, verbose=True)

        if problem.status in ["infeasible", "unbounded"]:
            status = "infeasible"
        else:
            status = "optimal"

        # Extract results
        result = {
            'status': status,
            'vm': vm.value,
            'va': va.value,
            'pg': pg.value,
            'qg': qg.value,
            'objective_value': problem.objective.value
        }

        return result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error solving AC-OPF: {e}")
        return {
            'status': 'error',
            'error': str(e)
        }

def calculate_branch_flows(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """Calculate branch power flows"""
    buses = network_data['buses']
    branches = network_data['branches']
    bus_id_to_idx = {b['bus_id']: i for i, b in enumerate(buses)}

    flows = []

        tap = br['ratio'] if br['ratio'] != 0 else 1.0

        y = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)

        vf = vm[f_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[f_bus_idx])
        vt = vm[t_bus_idx] * np.exp(1j * va[t_bus_idx])

        if tap != 1.0:
            vf = vf / tap

        s_from = vf * np.conj(vf * (y + y_shunt)) - vf * np.conj(vt * y)
        s_to = vt * np.conj(vt * (y + y_shunt)) - vt * np.conj(vf * y)

        pf_from = np.real(s_from)
        qf_from = np.imag(s_from)
        pf_to = np.real(s_to)
        qf_to = np.imag(s_to)

        s_from_mva = np.abs(s_from)
        s_to_mva = np.abs(s_to)

        loading = max(s_from_mva, s_to_mva) / limit * 100 if limit > 0 else 0

        flows.append({
            'from_bus': br['f_bus'],
            'to_bus': br['t_bus'],
            'pf_from': pf_from,
            'qf_from': qf_from,
            'pt_from': pf_to,
            'qt_from': qf_to,
            's_from_mva': s_from_mva,
            's_to_mva': s_to_mva,
            'limit': limit,
            'loading_pct': loading
        })

    return flows

def generate_report(network_data: Dict, solution: Dict) -> Dict:
    """Generate the report in the required JSON format"""
    buses = network_data['buses']

    total_pd = np.sum([b['pd'] for b in buses])

    for i, bus in enumerate(buses):

        elif vm < bus['vmin']:

    # Calculate branch flows
    flows = calculate_branch_flows(network_data, solution)

            overload = flow['s_from_mva'] - flow['limit']
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Get most loaded branches
    most_loaded = sorted(flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]

    # Format generator data
    gen_data = []
    for i, gen in enumerate(generators):
        if gen['status'] == 1:
            gen_data.append({
                'id': i + 1,
                'bus': gen['gen_bus'],

    bus_data = []

            'va_deg': float(np.degrees(solution['va'][i])),
            'vmin_pu': float(bus['vmin']),
            'vmax_pu': float(bus['vmax'])
        })

    # Format most loaded branches
    most_loaded_branches = []
    for flow in most_loaded:
        most_loaded_branches.append({
            'from_bus': flow['from_bus'],
            'to_bus': flow['to_bus'],
            'loading_pct': float(flow['loading_pct']),
            'flow_from_MVA': float(flow['s_from_mva']),
            'flow_to_MVA': float(flow['s_to_mva']),
            'limit_MVA': float(flow['limit'])
        })

    # Determine solver status
    solver_status = "optimal" if solution['status'] == "optimal" else "infeasible"

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": float(solution['objective_value']) if solution['objective_value'] is not None else 0.0,
            "total_load_MW": float(total_pd),
            "total_load_MVAr": float(total_qd),
            "total_generation_MW": float(total_pg),
            "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_qg),
            "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses),
            "solver_status": solver_status
        },
        "generators": gen_data,
        "buses": bus_data,
        "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded_branches,
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": float(max_p_mismatch),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mismatch),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_voltage_violation),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_branch_overload)
        }
    }

    return report

def main():
    """Main execution function"""
    print("Loading network data...")
    network_data = load_network('network.json')

    print(f"Network loaded:")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['buses'])} buses")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['generators'])} generators")
    print(f"  - {len(network_data['branches'])} branches")

    print("\nSolving AC-OPF...")
    solution = solve_acopf(network_data)

    if solution['status'] != 'optimal':
        print(f"Warning: Solution status is {solution['status']}")

    print("\nGenerating report...")
    report = generate_report(network_data, solution)

    print("\nWriting report to report.json...")
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("\nSummary:")
    print(f"  Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:,.2f}/hr")
    print(f"  Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:,.2f} MW")
    print(f"  Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")

    print("\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.6f} MVA")

    print("\nReport written to report.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
